english.notes:

(iii) Section 22 of the Policing and Crime Act 2009 disables section 127 of the Magistrates' Courts Act 1980 by creating a new section 132A in the Sexual Offences Act 2003. It also provides for the offence to be charged even if committed before the commencement of the section

other.penalty:
Summary: Fifty one weeks imprisonment OR a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Note:
Until the commencement of section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 the reference to 51 weeks is to be read as a reference to 6 months.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
